statements.label: supported
statements.text: SLNCR carries four triplex-forming regions, homologous to the triplex-forming regions of the MEG3, HOTAIR and PARTICLE lncRNAs.
statements.evidence: The primary sequence of SLNCR contains four triplex-forming regions (TFRs), which are homologous to the TFRs of MEG3, HOTAIR , and PARTICLE lncRNAs.
statements.note: The abstract gives both the count of triplex-forming regions and their homology to those three lncRNAs.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Raising full-length SLNCR levels increased melanoma cell proliferation, migration and invasion, with expression shifts in cell cycle regulation and cell migration pathways.
statements.evidence: Full-length SLNCR overexpression promotes proliferation, migration, and invasion of melanoma cells by inducing characteristic gene expression changes of genes that are enriched in pathways involved in cell cycle regulation and cell migration.
statements.note: This is reported directly as the effect of overexpressing the full-length transcript.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Oligos that prevent SLNCR triplex formation undid SLNCR-driven melanoma cell migration ex vivo.
statements.evidence: Finally, inhibitory oligos that block SLNCR •DNA:DNA triplex formation reversed the effect of SLNCR -mediated migration ex vivo
statements.note: The abstract reports exactly this reversal by the triplex-blocking oligos.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Treating melanoma-bearing mice with the triplex-blocking oligos reduced tumour growth.
statements.evidence: Finally, inhibitory oligos that block SLNCR •DNA:DNA triplex formation reversed the effect of SLNCR -mediated migration ex vivo
statements.note: The oligos were tested against migration ex vivo; no animal tumour growth experiment is reported either way.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Patients with PDAC carried substantially fewer total exosomal small RNAs than control individuals.
statements.evidence: The total Ex-smRNA count was substantially reduced in patients with PDAC compared with that in control individuals.
statements.note: The abstract states the total Ex-smRNA count was reduced in PDAC relative to controls.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: miR-142-5p improves treatment response in PDAC by suppressing BACH1.
statements.evidence: The expressions of CARS1-AS1 and miR-142-5p were upregulated in treatment-responsive patients.
statements.note: Higher miR-142-5p in responders is reported, but no causal mechanism for it, and no link to BACH1, is tested.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: miR-125a-5p, miR-30e-5p, miR-16-2-3p, miR-98-5p and the let-7 family were suppressed in PDAC, whereas miR-6731-5p ran in the opposite direction and was elevated.
statements.evidence: The levels of microRNAs (miRNAs) miR-125a-5p, miR-30e-5p, miR-16-2-3p, miR-98-5p, and the let-7 family were significantly suppressed, whereas that of miR-6731-5p was significantly elevated.
statements.note: Both the suppressed set and the single elevated miRNA are listed in the results.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: CARS1-AS1 was linked to better overall survival with an adjusted hazard ratio of 0.33 (95% CI 0.15-0.73).
statements.evidence: CARS1-AS1 (adjusted hazard ratio [HR] 0.33; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.15-0.73; P =0.0061) and miR-142-5p (adjusted HR 0.79; 95% CI, 0.61-1.01; P = 0.0581) were associated with improved overall survival.
statements.note: The multivariable Cox result gives this hazard ratio and interval for CARS1-AS1.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: The lncRNA1 regulatory axis also controls trehalose levels in dipteran insects such as Drosophila melanogaster.
statements.evidence: This regulatory axis is functionally conserved in Spodoptera frugiperda , validated across loss-of-function, gain-of-function, and cell-based systems.
statements.note: Conservation is shown for a second lepidopteran species only; no other insect order is examined or excluded.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Silencing lncRNA1 in Helicoverpa armigera raised TPS/TPP and Treh transcripts and enzyme activities, lowered haemolymph trehalose and pushed glucose up.
statements.evidence: RNAi-mediated silencing of lncRNA1 in Helicoverpa armigera elevates TPS/TPP and Treh transcript abundance, increases enzyme activities, reduces haemolymph trehalose, raises glucose.
statements.note: Each of these directions is reported as a consequence of RNAi against lncRNA1.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Larval growth accelerated after lncRNA1 knockdown, and overexpressing lncRNA1 reversed the phenotypes.
statements.evidence: resulting in accelerated larval growth. Overexpression of lncRNA1 reverses these phenotypes.
statements.note: The abstract reports faster larval growth on knockdown and reversal on overexpression.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: lncRNA1 binds TPS/TPP and Treh mRNAs through conserved sequence motifs, and deleting those motifs removed its regulatory activity.
statements.evidence: Mechanistically, lncRNA1 physically associates with TPS/TPP and Treh mRNAs through evolutionarily conserved sequence motifs, modulating their post-transcriptional dynamics. Targeted deletion of these motifs abolishes regulatory activity and disrupts metabolic homeostasis.
statements.note: Both the physical association via conserved motifs and the loss of activity on motif deletion are stated.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Three conserved RG motifs were found in PRG-1 by alignment across Caenorhabditis species, and mass spectrometry showed them to be methylated.
statements.evidence: Sequence alignment across Caenorhabditis species reveals three conserved RG motifs, which we confirm to be methylated by mass spectrometry.
statements.note: The number of conserved motifs and their methylation are both reported.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The RG motifs were dispensable for PRG-1 expression, localisation and piRNA loading, but fertility, germline morphology and piRNA silencing depended on them.
statements.evidence: While the RG motifs are critical for fertility, germline morphology, and Piwi-interacting RNAs (piRNAs) silencing, they are not required for PRG-1 expression, localization, or piRNA loading.
statements.note: The abstract splits the motifs' requirements exactly this way.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: PRMT5 is the methyltransferase that modifies the RG motifs of PRG-1.
statements.evidence: Sequence alignment across Caenorhabditis species reveals three conserved RG motifs, which we confirm to be methylated by mass spectrometry.
statements.note: Methylation of the motifs is confirmed, but the abstract never identifies the enzyme responsible.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Mutating the RG motifs depleted WAGO-class siRNAs while leaving piRNA biogenesis intact.
statements.evidence: Notably, mutation of the RG motifs results in defects in downstream small RNA production, specifically the depletion of WAGO-class small interfering RNAs (siRNAs), without affecting piRNA biogenesis.
statements.note: The abstract reports loss of WAGO-class siRNAs with piRNA biogenesis unaffected.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The predicted regulatory network held 4 circRNAs, 14 miRNAs and 12 mRNAs.
statements.evidence: we successfully predicted a circRNA-miRNA-mRNA network, comprising 4 circRNAs, 14 miRNAs and 12 mRNAs
statements.note: These are the component counts given for the predicted network.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: In hippocampal tissue from POCD mice, mmu_miR-337-3p, SLC25A13 mRNA and GPR171 mRNA sat below control levels.
statements.evidence: while the levels of mmu_circRNA_009396, mmu_miR-6912-5p, mmu_miR-362-3p, mmu_miR-337-3p, SLC25A13 mRNA, and GPR171 mRNA were reduced in the hippocampal tissues of POCD mice compared to the control group
statements.note: RT-qPCR placed all three among the reduced species in POCD hippocampus versus controls.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Every predicted circRNA-miRNA-mRNA path reached an AUC above 0.8 for diagnosing POCD.
statements.evidence: The AUC value of each predicted circRNA-miRNA-mRNA path in diagnosing POCD exceeded 0.8.
statements.note: The abstract reports this AUC threshold for each predicted path.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Knocking down mmu_circRNA_009748 in mice reduced postoperative memory impairment.
statements.evidence: Dual-luciferase assays further confirmed the direct interactions of mmu_circ_0001838 with mmu-miR-337-3p and mmu-miR-337-3p with PLA2G12B mRNA.
statements.note: Interactions were verified in cells; no circRNA knockdown or behavioural outcome in animals is reported.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Ovarian cancer patients showed raised ALKBH5 expression alongside a general drop in m6A levels.
statements.evidence: We identified the elevated expression of ALKBH5 and a general reduction in the level of m6A in ovarian cancer patients.
statements.note: Both the higher ALKBH5 and the lower m6A in patients are stated as findings.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: High ALKBH5 protein expression went with shorter overall survival in ovarian cancer patients.
statements.evidence: we examined ALKBH5 protein expression and m6A levels by immunohistochemistry and analyzed their correlation with clinical features and prognosis in patients with ovarian cancer
statements.note: The abstract says prognosis was analysed but never reports the direction of any survival association.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Depleting ALKBH5 in A2780 cells by siRNA or CRISPR/Cas9 knockout cut m6A levels and held back viability, proliferation and migration.
statements.evidence: In the ovarian cancer cell line A2780, ALKBH5 depletion was found using the siRNA strategy or the CRISPR/Cas9 knockout (KO) method, which significantly reduced the level of m6A and inhibited cell viability, proliferation, and migration.
statements.note: The abstract reports both the m6A reduction and the inhibited cell phenotypes after ALKBH5 depletion.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: ALKBH5 knockdown left SRSF10 exon 5 retained more often and lowered expression of the SRSF10-211 transcript.
statements.evidence: ALKBH5 knockdown resulted in increased retention of SRSF10 exon 5 and decreased expression of transcript SRSF10-211.
statements.note: Both splicing changes are reported as consequences of ALKBH5 knockdown.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: LINC02207 is significantly downregulated in TNBC tissue, and its low expression goes together with poorer survival.
statements.evidence: This study finds long non-coding RNA LINC02207 is significantly downregulated in TNBC tissues and low expression correlates with poorer survival.
statements.note: The abstract reports the downregulation and the survival correlation together.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Nuclear LINC02207 holds back cell proliferation, drives cuproptosis and makes cells more sensitive to Elesclomol.
statements.evidence: It localizes in nucleus, acts as tumor suppressor by inhibiting cell proliferation, positively regulates cuproptosis and enhances sensitivity to Elesclomol.
statements.note: Localisation, the anti-proliferative effect, the cuproptosis effect and the Elesclomol sensitisation are all stated.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Circulating LINC02207 levels separate TNBC patients from healthy women in blood samples.
statements.evidence: This study finds long non-coding RNA LINC02207 is significantly downregulated in TNBC tissues and low expression correlates with poorer survival.
statements.note: Expression was assessed in tumour tissue; nothing is reported about measuring it in blood.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Overexpressing LINC02207 suppressed tumour growth in animal models by promoting cuproptosis.
statements.evidence: In vivo models confirm its overexpression suppresses tumor growth by promoting cuproptosis.
statements.note: This is reported as the in vivo result for LINC02207 overexpression.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Cutting a small RNA out of a host mRNA exon measurably lowered the amount of protein made from that host gene.
statements.evidence: Relatedly, processing of a small RNA from an exon of a protein-coding mRNA, in principle, may destabilize it and compromise translation of the host gene.
statements.note: This is raised as a theoretical possibility in the background; no measurement of host protein output is reported.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The analysis turned up 201 small RNAs, 118 human and 83 mouse, encoded by expressed exons of protein-coding genes.
statements.evidence: Our analysis finds 201 small RNAs (118 human and 83 mouse) encoded by expressed exons of protein-coding genes (5'-UTR, CDS, 3'-UTR).
statements.note: These totals and the human/mouse split are the headline counts of the analysis.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: 96% of the protein-coding host gene relationships reported here had not been known before.
statements.evidence: Many of these small RNAs are poorly characterized with 96% of the protein-coding host gene relationships identified here not previously known.
statements.note: The abstract gives this percentage for previously unknown host gene relationships.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: For a subset of these small RNAs, expression differed across human tissues and tracked significantly with that of the candidate host gene.
statements.evidence: Expression analysis for a subset of these small RNAs indicates that many display differential expression across human tissues with the pattern correlating significantly with the expression of the candidate protein-coding host gene.
statements.note: The expression analysis reports both tissue variation and significant correlation with the host gene.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: VCD exposure cut ovarian reserve, raised oxidative stress and produced severe chromosome segregation defects.
statements.evidence: VCD treatment reduces ovarian reserve, elevates oxidative stress, and causes severe chromosome segregation defects.
statements.note: All three effects of VCD treatment are listed in the abstract.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: VCD shifted the expression of m6A writers and erasers, changing methylation of transcripts needed for cell division and meiosis.
statements.evidence: We find that VCD dysregulates the expression of m6A writers and erasers, leading to altered methylation of transcripts critical for cell division and meiosis.
statements.note: The abstract reports dysregulated writers and erasers and the resulting methylation changes.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: VCD lowered the RNA-binding protein IGF2BP3, destabilising target genes required for chromosome alignment and spindle assembly.
statements.evidence: Specifically, VCD downregulates the RNA-binding protein IGF2BP3, which destabilizes target genes required for chromosome alignment and spindle assembly.
statements.note: This is stated as the specific mechanism found downstream of VCD exposure.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Restoring IGF2BP3 in VCD-exposed oocytes rescued chromosome alignment.
statements.evidence: Specifically, VCD downregulates the RNA-binding protein IGF2BP3, which destabilizes target genes required for chromosome alignment and spindle assembly.
statements.note: Downregulation of IGF2BP3 is reported, but no experiment putting it back is described.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Transposons and other germline-specific DNA make up roughly 80% of the Euplotes vannus germline genome and are removed during soma development.
statements.evidence: we report the high-quality germline genome assembly of a marine ciliate Euplotes vannus , where ~80% are transposons and other germline-specific DNA that has to be precisely eliminated during soma development
statements.note: The abstract gives this proportion for the germline assembly and says the DNA is eliminated.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: The 30-nucleotide small RNAs act by loading onto a PIWI-clade Argonaute protein in Euplotes.
statements.evidence: We demonstrate that a class of soma-derived 30-nucleotide small RNAs precisely targets nontransposon DNA against elimination during this process.
statements.note: The targeting role is reported, but no Argonaute or other protein partner for these small RNAs is named.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Targeting by these small RNAs kept working across different small RNA lengths and tolerated heterozygous sites.
statements.evidence: Small RNA-mediated targeting remains functional across varying small RNA lengths and is compatible with heterozygous sites.
statements.note: Both the length tolerance and the compatibility with heterozygous sites are reported.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The small RNAs come from Dicer-like cleavage of bidirectionally transcribed long noncoding RNAs that start at subtelomeric chromosome breakage sequences.
statements.evidence: These small RNAs are cleaved by Dicer-like ribonuclease from long noncoding RNAs, which are bidirectionally transcribed of somatic chromosomes, initiated at subtelomeric chromosome breakage sequences (5'-TTGAA-3').
statements.note: The abstract states the enzyme, the precursor transcripts and where their transcription starts.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: American nodavirus infection shortens the lifespan of live Phlebotomus papatasi sandflies.
statements.evidence: In this study, we identified and assembled a strain of American nodavirus (ANV) in the Phlebotomus papatasi-derived PP9ad cell line.
statements.note: The virus was characterised in a derived cell line; effects on live sandflies are neither reported nor ruled out.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: In PP9ad cells, American nodavirus replication was chiefly targeted by the exo-siRNA pathway, with the piRNA pathway barely engaged.
statements.evidence: we demonstrate that ANV replication in PP9ad cells is primarily targeted by the exogenous small interfering RNA (exo-siRNA) pathway, with minimal engagement from the PIWI-interacting RNA (piRNA) pathway
statements.note: Small RNA sequencing showed exo-siRNA dominance and minimal piRNA involvement.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The updated P. papatasi assembly Ppap_2.1 showed no expansion of PIWI proteins in sandflies.
statements.evidence: Our analysis of the updated P. papatasi genome (Ppap_2.1) has shown no PIWI protein expansion in sandflies.
statements.note: This is the genome analysis result reported for the newer assembly.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Both the siRNA and piRNA pathways were transcriptionally active in PP9ad cells, and mapped small RNAs gave typical piRNA signatures.
statements.evidence: We found that both siRNA and piRNA pathways are transcriptionally active in PP9ad cells, with genomic mapping of small RNAs generating typical piRNA signatures.
statements.note: Transcriptional activity of both pathways and the piRNA signatures are reported together.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The SERS assay picked up a circCDR1as mimic down to a detection limit of 1 pM.
statements.evidence: This method demonstrated sensitive and selective detection of a circCDR1as mimic, with a detection limit of 1 pM.
statements.note: The abstract gives 1 pM as the detection limit reached with the mimic.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: circCDR1as levels were markedly higher in MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cells than in MCF-10A normal breast epithelial cells, which let the sensor tell the two apart.
statements.evidence: Furthermore, the biosensor effectively discriminated breast cancer cells (MDA-MB-231) from normal breast epithelial cells (MCF-10A) by detecting markedly elevated levels of circCDR1as in the malignant cells.
statements.note: The discrimination and the elevated circCDR1as in the malignant line are both reported.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: The biosensor measured circCDR1as in plasma samples from breast cancer patients.
statements.evidence: Furthermore, the biosensor effectively discriminated breast cancer cells (MDA-MB-231) from normal breast epithelial cells (MCF-10A) by detecting markedly elevated levels of circCDR1as in the malignant cells.
statements.note: Testing is reported on a synthetic mimic and cultured cell lines; patient samples are not mentioned.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: DTNB-labelled plasmonic nanoparticles hybridise onto the magnetic beads to form a core-satellite structure that strongly boosts the SERS signal.
statements.evidence: Then, plasmonic nanoparticles labeled with a Raman reporter (5,5'-dithio bis-(2-nitrobenzoic acid), DTNB) attach to the bead surface through complementary hybridization, forming a core-satellite structure that greatly enhances the SERS signal.
statements.note: The abstract describes this assembly step and the signal enhancement it produces.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: piRAT annotates primary piRNAs from clusters as well as secondary piRNAs made through the ping-pong cycle, working from genome-mapped small RNA-seq data.
statements.evidence: We present piRAT, a piR NA A nnotation T ool for annotating both primary piRNAs from piRNA clusters and secondary piRNAs generated via the ping-pong cycle, using small RNA-seq data mapped to a genome.
statements.note: These are the two piRNA classes the tool is reported to annotate, from mapped small RNA-seq input.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: piRAT is implemented in Python 3 under an MIT license and can be installed through pip, conda or a Docker container.
statements.evidence: piRAT is available on GitHub ( https://github.com/ylla-lab/piRAT ), implemented in Python 3, and released under MIT license. It is also installable through pip, conda, and available as Docker container
statements.note: Language, license and the three installation routes are all listed in the availability section.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Linux supports the Python version natively, Windows needs WSL for it, and the Docker image additionally covers MacOS.
statements.evidence: The Python implementation runs natively on Linux and in WSL in Windows, and the Docker image can run on Linux, Windows, and MacOS.
statements.note: The abstract splits platform support exactly this way between the Python implementation and the Docker image.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: piRAT annotated piRNA clusters more accurately than previously published annotation tools.
statements.evidence: However, there is a lack of robust computational tools that facilitate their accurate annotation, analysis, and visualization, which would allow large-scale analysis of piRNAs across samples and species.
statements.note: A gap in existing tools motivates the work, but no benchmark against other tools is reported.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Overexpressing hnRNP A1 in HEK-293FT cells raised MIR17HG-i3 isoform levels, which went together with more pre-miR-19a.
statements.evidence: Reverse transcription quantitative PCR (RT-qPCR) analysis indicated higher levels of MIR17HG-i3 isoforms, which correlated with increase on pre-miR-19a generation upon hnRNP A1 overexpression.
statements.note: The RT-qPCR result links hnRNP A1 overexpression to both the isoform increase and more pre-miR-19a.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: hnRNP A1 overexpression increased proliferation of the HEK-293FT cells used here.
statements.evidence: We previously showed hnRNP A1 overexpression increases invasion and cell growth in thyroid carcinoma cells through association with miR-17a and miR-18a.
statements.note: Growth effects come from earlier work in thyroid carcinoma cells; no proliferation measurement in HEK-293FT cells is reported.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Cells overexpressing hnRNP K did not show the isoform pattern seen with hnRNP A1.
statements.evidence: Surprisingly, the same pattern was not observed in cells overexpressing hnRNP K.
statements.note: The abstract explicitly reports the absence of the pattern for hnRNP K.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Luciferase reporter assays confirmed a higher amount of functional miR-19a in hnRNP A1-overexpressing cells.
statements.evidence: Higher concentration of functional miR-19a in hnRNP A1 overexpressing cells was confirmed by luciferase reporter assays.
statements.note: This is the reporter assay result given for functional miR-19a.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: NCRDLLM predictions of ncRNA-drug associations were confirmed in cell-based drug response experiments.
statements.evidence: Ablation studies confirm the contribution of each module, while literature evidence and tissue-specific expression profiling further support the biological relevance of the predictions.
statements.note: Support comes from existing literature and expression profiling; no new wet-lab validation is reported.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: NCRDLLM reached its highest AUC-ROC on the lncRNA-drug dataset, 0.9832, above its miRNA-drug and circRNA-drug values.
statements.evidence: Experimental results demonstrate that NCRDLLM achieves AUC-ROC values of 0.9665, 0.9832, and 0.9676 on miRNA-drug, lncRNA-drug, and circRNA-drug data sets, respectively.
statements.note: The three AUC-ROC values are given in that order, and the lncRNA-drug one is the largest.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The framework was built on 19,020 experimentally validated associations together with 120,009 disease association records.
statements.evidence: The method integrates 19,020 experimentally validated associations and 120,009 disease association records.
statements.note: These are the data volumes the method is reported to integrate.

statements.text: Multimodal features were mapped into the hidden space of LLaMA-3.2-3B through adapter modules, with LoRA used for parameter-efficient fine-tuning.
statements.evidence: These features are subsequently mapped into the hidden space of LLaMA-3.2-3B through adapter modules, with LoRA employed for parameter-efficient fine-tuning.
statements.note: The abstract describes this adapter-plus-LoRA arrangement for the feature mapping.
